observations: Three photos showing Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBCs) in metal cages.
Photo 0: IBC with a blue discharge valve and a heavily rusted metal pallet base.
Photo 1: IBC with black plastic corner protectors at the base and a cleaner cage structure.
Photo 2: IBC with a blue and yellow valve and a very rusty cage, elevated on concrete blocks.
The plastic containers show significant yellowing, staining, and weathering.
The tanks are stacked, indicating a larger inventory than a single unit.
Watermarks 'ADEDEJI ADEOBA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all images.

claims.evidence: Only approximately 6 distinct units are visible across the provided photos.
The design and scale are consistent with standard 1000-liter IBC containers.
These are standard industrial-grade bulk containers.

risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's original content label or a clear shot of the tank interior.
Video showing the discharge valves being operated.

risks.risk: Structural cage failure due to rust
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted structural joints and the base.
A wide-angle photo or video showing the full lot of 50 units.

proof_requests: Wide-angle photo or video showing all 50 units to verify the total quantity.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the tanks to identify previous contents.
Video demonstrating the operation of the discharge valves.
Close-up photos of the rusted cage bases to assess structural integrity.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as used IBC tanks. Their visible condition is poor with significant rust and weathering, allowing for a worst-case valuation as non-potable industrial containers.
